standard_prerequisites.name: Standard smooth presentation with prescribed coordinates
standard_prerequisites.use: Chooses the presentation in which A's coordinates appear among B'.

core_obligations: Standardize B' over S^{-1}R by the smooth-standard-smooth lemma and choose the standard smooth presentation including the coordinates of A.
Multiply the new coordinates by elements of S so that B' -> S^{-1}Lambda maps them to fractions lambda_i/1 with lambda_i in Lambda.

Clear denominators in the Jacobian relation 1 = a_0 det + sum a_j f_j to get s_0 in S with s_0 = a_0 det + sum a_j f_j over R[x], and find s_j, s'_j in S killing the g_j and the f_j(lambda) respectively.

Set B = R[x_1, ..., x_{n+m}]/(s'_1 f_1, ..., s'_c f_c, g_1, ..., g_t) with the displayed map to Lambda; verify the displayed identity showing s = s_0 s_1 ... s_t s'_1 ... s'_c is elementary standard in B over R.
proof_roadmap: Standardization; denominator clearing; killing relations by elements of S; elementary standard verification.
difficulty_reason: A four-step construction; the substance is the displayed elementary-standard identity for the product denominator, carried explicitly.
